resources.string: Sui permissions are separate from kernel Root permissions.

Disabling requests the broker to stop. A full reboot is required to remove injection and end privileges or user services already running. Updating Manager does not automatically replace an installed Sui module.

Requires an active ReZygisk or NeoZygisk backend and a full reboot. SystemUI and Settings must not be excluded from injection. This does not enable ZNN or ADB Root. Keep a working recovery path. Sui has its own privileged permission database.
Root and Shell services connected; permission host attached
Enabled but service or permission host is unavailable
UI simulation only. Refresh simulates a completed reboot; no real Sui service runs.
Keep the Manager running to receive permission requests. Requests without a host are denied; enabling Sui does not automatically grant apps access.
Changes apply to every package sharing this UID. Revoking Sui permissions does not change kernel Root grants.
Open LunexSU to review the requesting app and privilege level
